details:
This idea comes from recently getting notified game tags were removed from my worlds since it wasn’t a specifically a game world but more of a social world with games in it too. 

This is great. Organisation which we need (also sorry for being part of the problem)

I would like to put forward the idea of catagory selection on the upload screen for the SDK which is separate from tags which forces users into a single category. This may discourage abusing the system and also means less moderation for the vrc team. It also allows everyone to use any tags including game so people know at least there is games in it. 

As for the most part the core game is focused more on socialising meaning you currently could get away with the selection of 2 category’s ‘Game’ & ‘Avatar’. 

Example:

If your world is one of the following please make a selection. 

Or just add a third to avoid confusion 

‘not applicable’ 

I believe this will help with automatic organisation and less work load.

I’m sure you’ve already thought of something similar and if not better.
title: Category Selection
